description: tidyhydat is an rOpenSci R package that imports and reshapes Water Survey of Canada hydrometric records. It queries historical HYDAT observations and current web services, returns tidy tables, and provides station-search functions. The current documentation distinguishes validated historical measurements from provisional observations and shows functions for daily discharge, water levels and other available parameters. Coverage is Canadian, with the period and sampling interval depending on the station and source. These tables can calibrate river-flow models or supply boundary conditions for reservoir and flood simulations. Source code and installation instructions are available through GitHub and CRAN under Apache-2.0. Some workflows require a separately obtained HYDAT database, while the documented web-service option can handle smaller requests. A limitation is that provisional records can change and must not be treated as final measurements. The existing data-canada-hydat-national-water-data-archive describes its main data source, not this software interface. No hydrometric data were downloaded or model results reproduced in this review. The code is available free of charge under its stated licence.
